methods.title: PowerShell collection before pipeline
methods.failure_signature: A direct foreach-to-pipeline inventory expression was rejected before any read.
methods.recurrence_guard: Assign foreach results to an array before piping.

methods.title: Split remote and storage probes
methods.failure_signature: A combined fetch, status, storage and receipt probe exceeded the caller window with no attributable output.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use scalar Git probes and inspect live processes before any retry.

methods.title: Simple source-heading classifier
methods.failure_signature: A quoted heading regex was rejected by PowerShell before source analysis.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use a small ASCII-safe heading grammar and keep theme counts separate.

methods.title: Browser recovery for X source
methods.failure_signature: The hidden in-app browser open timed out before a result.
methods.recurrence_guard: Select the existing browser once, create one focused tab, and inspect the public post read-only.

methods.title: Scalar tool version probes
methods.failure_signature: A combined version projection returned no aggregate while npm version remained alive beyond the caller window.
methods.recurrence_guard: Probe only tools materially used and bound each result independently.
